objective: Replace VIN-dependent work with at least 50 distinct, attributed photo additions to existing cars; prioritize Leclerc and validate bilingual captions before publication.
reason: User explicitly requested photos first if full VINs cannot be confirmed. The goal API cannot replace its blocked unfinished VIN goal; this records the new authorized scope without falsely completing it.
verification: All selected published image URLs downloaded successfully and visually inspected in contact sheets alongside existing galleries.
Drive Vintage gallery: omitted six near-identical views/crops in addition to existing images.
Leclerc: omitted composite image and near-identical frames; selected ten distinct handover, presentation, interior and waterfront images.
Tiriac: new hero selected; two changed gallery URLs show existing cockpit/wheel photos and were excluded.
No generated images, inferred VINs, new ownership assertions or copied local media assets. Existing source-only fallback retained.
rejected_sources: Carrio old listing now resolves to general inventory; unrelated vehicle pictures excluded.
Classic Driver withdrawn listings expose only the existing cover photo.
